name: Claude Duet
desc: Proactive agent that messages you about inbox and calendar
desc_zh: 主动盯收件箱和日历、有事先找你的智能体
solves: Checking inbox and calendar all day breaks focus; Claude Duet watches them, drafts next steps and pings you when needed.
solves_zh: 整天盯着收件箱和日历打断专注，Claude Duet 替你盯着，有需要再找你。
best_for: You wake up to 60 unread threads and want the two that need a reply today.
best_for_zh: 早上打开邮箱有六十封未读，只想先看今天必须回的两封。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C — https://techcrunch.com/tag/claude/ (then D: claude.com product index)）。 Research preview opened by public waitlist on 2026-10-21 for US Pro, Max and Ultra subscribers. The product page meta still says 'Research preview: join the waitlist' while its body says it is available in Pro, Max and Ultra plans in the US, so a wider rollout date was not confirmed. Standalone app on iOS and Android plus claude.ai. 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/claude-duet
